sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite model card
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete July 21, 2026 card on October 27. Its dependency and architecture sections explicitly identify Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite as the base, rather than merely a related model. Neither its model information nor its exact-model benchmark/safety tables publishes a numerical total or active count; price and performance comparisons have no parameter-size row.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite API specifications
sources.evidence: Exact stable API ID gemini-3.5-flash-lite: 1,048,576 input tokens and 65,536 output tokens; text, image, video, audio and PDF inputs; text output; thinking and function calling. Reopened October 27 for the parameter audit: the complete specification table gives no total or active weight count.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
sources.evidence: The July 21, 2026 announcement explicitly makes 3.5 Flash-Lite available that day in Google applications and APIs. Reopened October 27: high-throughput, latency and price claims contain no numerical model size or count-bearing base beyond the separately documented card lineage.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of the complete original card. It explicitly names Gemini 3 Pro as the base and architecture reference, but provides no numerical total or active count. Its comparison tables give benchmark, price and speed results, not parameter sizes. This named relationship could support nominal inheritance if a base size were published.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of the complete May 2026 Pro PDF. The named base describes sparse MoE token routing qualitatively, without expert sizes, routing width or numerical total/active counts. The card identifies Pro as a new model and includes 3.1 Flash-Lite in its dependent family; it supplies no count to inherit through that chain.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Google API access is governed by service-specific terms; extracting or replicating underlying model parameter weights is prohibited. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification, rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-disclosure check of the complete September card: the 3.8 Flash dependency is 3.7 Flash, and no retrospective numerical total or active count for 3.5 Flash-Lite is published in its model or comparison material.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 later-disclosure check of the complete decoded Argon card: Argon is explicitly a new model, not a prior-model fine-tune. Its architecture and comparisons publish no retrospective numerical size for 3.5 Flash-Lite.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
sources.evidence: Identifies this exact model in the Flash-Lite line, lists July 21, 2026 as the GA release, and corroborates its 1,048,576-token context, text output, multimodal inputs, thinking and function calling.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite record
sources.evidence: Baseline lead inspected. Contains the unhyphenated display name, normalized gemini-flash-lite family, date, input limit and capability flags; primary Google sources independently verify the factual specifications.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of all exact-model and parameter occurrences in the complete report. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is used as a weaker monitor in chain-of-thought evasion experiments, but no numerical model size is supplied. Parameter mentions concern task difficulty, model security and encoded knowledge, not total or activated parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Model Evaluation: Approach, Methodology and Results
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model search located the original three-page July evaluation appendix. Read the complete PDF October 27 and visually checked its final comparison table. It explicitly uses gemini-3.5-flash-lite with high thinking and default sampling. Methodology and table report evaluation settings, prices and benchmark scores; no total or active parameter count is present.

name.note: Use Google's official hyphenated model name.

developer.note: Google DeepMind publishes the model; Google is the existing developer normalization.

family.note: Normalized Flash-Lite subfamily within Gemini 3; distinct from the full Flash line.

release_date.note: Announcement states availability that day; corroborated by the exact API model release date.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is hosted applications/APIs under service terms, with no released checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive classification for Google-controlled API access under Gemini API terms.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name/ID total-size and named-base searches, original card/API/launch and evaluation appendix, and later primary comparisons found no supported nominal total. The explicit 3.5 Flash-Lite to 3.1 Flash-Lite to Gemini 3 Pro dependency is relevant lineage, but none has a published numerical count to inherit. Null reflects missing numeric evidence, not an exact tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count searches and original/later primary comparison checks found no numerical per-token active count. Sparse expert routing is documented without expert dimensions or routing quantities. Neither benchmark results, monitor capability, throughput nor a named base without a count establishes an active size.

architecture.note: Explicit architecture-reference chain: 3.5 Flash-Lite -> 3.1 Flash-Lite -> Gemini 3 Pro. The final referenced card specifies a sparse MoE Transformer. This is an explicit architectural delegation, not a transfer of sibling parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact documented input/context limit. The separate output maximum is 65,536 tokens.

modalities.note: Exact API data-type list, including PDF as the existing catalog document-input type. No audio or image generation.

reasoning.note: Thinking is explicitly supported; thinking levels permit adjusting inference effort.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts after independent exact-name/ID searches, reopened original card/API/launch and named-base chain, the evaluation appendix, and later Gemini 3.8/4 Argon cards and safety comparisons. The lineage is explicit but supplies no published count. All unrelated assessments and corrections are preserved.
